milestone: Stage 2 Candidate-Edge Gating Evaluation with G0_STRUCTURAL_MASK

new_files.description: Paired evaluation runner executing Stage 2 candidate matching and gating on SWaT A4/A5 with G0 enabled vs disabled.
Comprehensive unit tests verifying register SHA-256 integrity, gate ordering, prohibition filtering, conservative policy enforcement, metric calculations, and artifact existence.
Machine-readable evaluation parameters including windowing, thresholds, delay bounds, and register configuration.
Overall and per-attack paired gating metrics, reduction statistics, and channel event counts.
Full tabular comparison of all 3,852 candidate edges with Config A vs Config B gate decisions, reject reasons, and register metadata.
Breakdown of candidate counts, accepted/rejected totals, and reduction percentages across all 6 attack intervals and outside intervals.
Frequencies of each rejection reason across Config A and Config B mapped to their respective gating stages.
Pytest execution log verifying test suite pass.
Comprehensive scientific evaluation report documenting paired gating findings, edge reductions, surviving physical relationships, limitations, and recommendations.
Machine-readable manifest of all changes and preserved reference directories.
